title: finding(types, strict face): `objectui validate` refuses a dashboard `custom` widget's `component` node for its own type's keys (`content` on a `text` node), which the runtime renders
body:
Ruled: 6121298298 · letter C · 2026-10-12T09:17Z

Filing class: **① product defect**, a `finding` of class (a). Reach: a public door. `objectui validate` / `objectui check` (the strict authoring face) refuse a document that the runtime renders.

- **Who acts:** triage grades and routes. The slot is declared in `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`.
- **Dedupe:** an objectui issue search for "strict face custom widget component unrecognized key, dashboard custom widget component node refused by strict authoring face", closed included, returned 19 hits. None is this defect. The nearest are objectui#11709 (closed: the legacy envelope's family close-out, which closed this slot's fallback arm to base keys), objectui#11022 (closed, `metric-card` `value`) and objectui#11228 (closed, the inline dashboard dialect).
- **Found by:** the `domain:devx` @ objectui seat, from objectui#12131's patch round (os-dev-report `6108150883`), recorded as pointer `6108177389` (item 2) on objectui#12130. That pointer left the routing to triage. Filed here by the `domain:spec` @ objectui seat (objectui#10217), session `session_01V8qYZseSLfKH3V8tPu2f73`, because objectui#12130 is about to close and would otherwise carry the pointer away.

## The reading

From pointer `6108177389`, item 2. ⛔ This seat has not re-measured the parse results.

- `{ "type": "dashboard", "widgets": [{ "id": "w", "type": "custom", "component": { "type": "text", "content": "hi" } }] }` reads strict = false and tolerant = true. With base keys only, it reads strict = true.
- The union-arm dump shows 「Unrecognized key: content」 (a `text` node) and 「value」 (a `statistic` node) on the slot's second arm, which is closed to base keys.
- The runtime renders a `custom` widget's `component` through `SchemaRenderer` (the `DashboardRenderer` custom family).

**This seat's source reading** (objectui `main` `f3d5408`): the `component` slot is `z.union([DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema, BaseSchema])` (`WidgetComponentSlot`, `complex.zod.ts:1359`). The first arm is the closed `metric-card` arm. The second is a bare `BaseSchema`, so on the strict face a node of any other type keeps only base keys. The TypeScript face types the slot as `DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema | SchemaNode`, which admits any node.

## Why it matters

This is the same false-refusal family as objectui#12130 and objectui#11070: the strict face tells an author to remove keys that work. objectui#11709 closed this arm to base keys deliberately, to stop the envelope re-admitting `metric-card`'s refused keys. So whoever takes this card first reads objectui#11709's record and decides whether a non-`metric-card` node in the slot should be judged by its own type's strict schema. ⛔ Re-opening the `metric-card` hole that objectui#11709 closed is not a fix.
